import random
import string

def generate_test_case():
    len1 = random.randint(0, 500)
    len2 = random.randint(0, 500)

    word1 = ''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase, k=len1))
    word2 = ''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase, k=len2))
